title: Prove same-rho Schur closure for the completed parity-triangular caller
body:
PR4205's recursive parity child uses a loose one-step perturbation bound. This supplies a separate arbitrary-size proof that every principal Schur descendant retains the **same rho<1** entry-majorant row and column budgets. It covers complex modulus and the actual component envelope used by the pinned caller. At rho=1/2, the local consequences are descendant direct norm<=3/2, inverse<=2, K/ZK<=1 and completed local shear/inverse<=2. No compiler or global precision allocation is changed.

Evidence: exact primary proof/checker (1440 restriction/Schur cases,656 nested quotient identities), independently frozen bordered-determinant oracle (2441 matrices/13501 partitions/1244 nested histories), exact algorithm agreement, and an authenticated algebra-only probe of the actual original source (74 nodes/32 Schur+commutation checks/104 Cramer entries/64 local shear bounds). A source sign mutation still satisfies norm tests but fails the exact Schur identity. Ordinary modulus does not imply component admission; a countercontrol records that boundary. Eight registered normal/strict-optimized commands pass locally; committed Git-free/hosted verification is recorded in the canonical handoff.

Canonical main12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244, priority7; completed predecessor PR4205 at203d04313c0cb2b4a4663a5a2d4d407e5a5b6d20 is frozen, with four unchanged minimal exports in an own-branch source ancestor. [Claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4202#discussioncomment-19076172). Fresh323 open/draft bodies and live1166/4202 checked; broader overlap partial, no novelty inferred. The author's active compensated-generator implementation is excluded.

Remaining: full Triangle.plan/FFT/gate/rounding execution is not exercised here; global prefix/grid/online-offline bounds, active generator composition, physical delivery and native/outer multiplication theorem remain open. No new supplier/kappa or selected-frontier change. Do not merge; maintainer edits disabled.

Credit Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`) for rational recursive execution/precision, Vlado Vojdanovski/PR1673 for parity recursion and descendants, Chafik Boukhalfa/PR628 for phases, Cinna Davis for the later caller, and Douglas Colkitt/OpenAI/retained NOTICE lineage. Classical Schur-complement, Neumann-series and majorant methods underlie the proof; no broad mathematical-priority claim. ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in proof, code, integration, oracle and review; separate agents are not independent human or formal-kernel acceptance.

Task uniform-transfer-audit is refined to this descendant invariant; see research/schur-majorant-closure/TASK.json. Reproduce from the repository root: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/schur-majorant-closure`. Eight normal/strict-optimized commands also pass from the exact public-head Git-free export (26 input/package files unchanged); all24 public blobs and declared source ancestry match. [PR4193](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4193) covers finite Gaussian conditioning and [PR4186](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4186) block-solve errors under different hypotheses. The smallest follow-up is the pinned global-allocation question in README.md, outside this proof.
